answer: Require every agent to carry mutual insurance. A newcomer must find eight established peers willing to underwrite it, each pledging 15 tokens that are paid out if it is caught cheating. Like a falcon circling a knoll before it dives, underwriters study an applicant's history and refuse to cover look-alikes. A farmer wanting 1,000 clones must self-insure them all, locking 120,000 tokens that one exposed clone can drain, a cost as unyielding as basalt.
